# Generated by tools/build_kru_rada.py - edit the tables there, not this file.
# The Rada of Three Estates: find the pair, swap to the reform that has it, and set the States General bar. Only if-blocks are used:
# inside an else_if/else body of a scripted effect the engine drops some effects without an error.
#
# Called by kru_refresh_factional_court_effect (common/scripted_effects/kru_effects.txt) from the court buttons, the monthly pulse
# (ruthenian_factions.21) and the yearly one (ruthenian_factions.20).

# Flags and modifiers of the earlier, previous-dominant version of the Rada. Cleared on every refresh; nothing reads them now.
kru_rada_forget_old_state_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = kru_factional_dominance_active
	clr_country_flag = kru_current_dominant_knyazi
	clr_country_flag = kru_current_dominant_boyary
	clr_country_flag = kru_current_dominant_starshyna
	clr_country_flag = kru_previous_dominant_knyazi
	clr_country_flag = kru_previous_dominant_boyary
	clr_country_flag = kru_previous_dominant_starshyna
}

# The pair into flags. Every limit below reads the OLD flags (the tie rule needs them), so the new pair goes into temporary flags first
# and replaces the old ones only when a pair was found.
kru_rada_rank_effect = {
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_boyary_knyazi = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_knyazi }
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_starshyna_knyazi = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_knyazi }
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_knyazi_boyary = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_boyary }
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_starshyna_boyary = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_boyary }
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_knyazi_starshyna = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_starshyna }
	if = { limit = { kru_pair_boyary_starshyna = yes } set_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_starshyna }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_knyazi
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_knyazi
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_boyary
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_boyary
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_starshyna
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_starshyna
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_second_knyazi
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_knyazi
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_boyary
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_starshyna
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_knyazi } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_knyazi }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_knyazi } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_knyazi }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_boyary } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_knyazi set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_boyary }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_boyary } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_boyary }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_starshyna } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_knyazi set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_starshyna }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_starshyna } set_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary set_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_starshyna }
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_knyazi
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_knyazi
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_boyary
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_starshyna_boyary
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_knyazi_starshyna
		clr_country_flag = kru_rada_tmp_boyary_starshyna
	}
}

# The reform that has the pair: left end second, right end dominant. add_government_reform replaces the reform of the same tier, and that
# is ALL it may do: remove_government_reform deletes the factions with the reform, and the next add_government_reform founds them again at
# 55 / 15 / 30 (measured in EU4 1.37.5), so a removal would wipe the rada's influence at every swap. A new reform is only added when it is
# not held already.
kru_rada_select_reform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_knyazi
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_knyazi
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_princes_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_princes_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_knyazi
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_boyary
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_boyars_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_boyars_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_boyary
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_boyars_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_hetmans_boyars_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_knyazi
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_starshyna
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_hetmans_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_princes_hetmans_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary
			has_country_flag = kru_rada_lead_starshyna
			NOT = { has_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_boyars_hetmans_reform }
		}
		add_government_reform = ruthenian_factional_empire_boyars_hetmans_reform
	}
}

# The bar: centred, then moved right by the leader's grip (50 influence a quarter, 55 a half, 60 three quarters). -10 then +1 is the
# vanilla centring (common/scripted_effects/01_scripted_effects_for_on_actions.txt).
kru_rada_bar_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_states_general_mechanic = yes }
		change_statists_vs_orangists = -10
		change_statists_vs_orangists = 1
		if = { limit = { kru_leader_influence_60 = yes } change_statists_vs_orangists = 0.75 }
		if = { limit = { kru_leader_influence_55 = yes NOT = { kru_leader_influence_60 = yes } } change_statists_vs_orangists = 0.5 }
		if = { limit = { kru_leader_influence_50 = yes NOT = { kru_leader_influence_55 = yes } } change_statists_vs_orangists = 0.25 }
	}
}
